description: Surface match and param-extraction accuracy signals feeding the Phase 8 eval harness, expose the auto-exec confidence threshold theta as a config lever, and support an optional architecture-cartographer DomainsService cross-check to enrich domain derivation.

requirements.description: Surface match accuracy and parameter-extraction accuracy signals from the behavioral probe pipeline, feeding them into the Phase 8 eval harness as named metrics. Expose the auto-execution confidence threshold theta as a named configuration lever (environment variable or config file key) with a documented default value. Optionally support an architecture-cartographer DomainsService cross-check RPC call to enrich domain derivation when the DomainsService is available, falling back gracefully to proto-schema-only derivation when it is not.
requirements.title: Eval and Observability Hooks for Match and Param-Extraction Accuracy

validation.notes: Go unit test: match accuracy metric is computed as matched_questions / total_questions and emitted as a named eval signal for each probe run
Go unit test: param-extraction accuracy metric is computed as correctly_extracted_params / total_params and emitted as a named eval signal
Go unit test: confidence threshold theta is read from config with correct default value and applied to auto-exec gate decisions
Go unit test: when DomainsService is unavailable (connection refused), domain derivation falls back to proto-schema-only path without error
Run the behavioral probe against a fixture scenario; assert the eval harness receives match_accuracy and param_extraction_accuracy metric events with float64 values in [0.0, 1.0]
Set theta config to 0.9 and run a probe where confidence is 0.85; assert auto-exec is NOT triggered; set theta to 0.8 and assert auto-exec IS triggered for the same measure

Boot measures-health with DomainsService address configured to a live stub; assert domain derivation report includes enriched domain metadata from DomainsService; shut down DomainsService and assert derivation still succeeds using proto schemas
Eval metric emission adds no more than 100ms overhead to a single probe run
Theta configuration lever is documented in the service README with its default value, valid range, and effect on auto-exec behavior

title: Eval and Observability Hooks
